hero.title: BBA / BBA (Hons.) Majoring in Digital Branding & Advertising

panes.label: Overview
panes.text:
The BBA / BBA (Hons.) in Digital Branding & Advertising at ATLAS ISME is designed to develop innovative, strategic and data-driven marketers who can lead the digital landscape and drive brand growth in a fast-evolving market. The program offers a strong foundation in digital marketing, consumer behaviour, social media strategies, content management and performance marketing.

Learning is immersive and practical, with live projects, marketing labs, industry simulations and masterclasses from experts. Students will explore every aspect of digital branding, including content creation, community management, data analytics and AI-driven advertising strategies. By the end of the program, you will be equipped to design impactful digital campaigns, manage brand presence across digital platforms and utilise cutting-edge tools to drive marketing success. Whether working with startups, established brands or launching your own venture, you will gain the skills to shape compelling digital brands and lead effective advertising strategies.

Marketing
cards.text: Go beyond the fundamentals of branding and consumer behaviour. The Marketing minor equips you to develop impactful campaigns, understand audience insights and build standout brands in today’s competitive landscape.

cards.title: Finance
cards.text: Master key financial concepts, including investment, valuation, and budgeting, to drive organisational growth. The Finance minor prepares you for careers in corporate finance, banking and investment management.

cards.title: Entrepreneurship
cards.text: Transform ideas into action by learning to launch ventures and drive innovation. This minor sharpens your creativity, leadership and problem-solving through real-world projects and collaboration.

cards.title: Economics
cards.text: Explore the economic forces and policies shaping global businesses and markets. Learn how economic analysis informs decision-making and drivesinnovation through public policy.

cards.title: AI & Emerging Technologies
cards.text: Understand how AI, machine learning and emerging technologies are reshaping industries and driving innovation, efficiency and growth.

cards.title: Business Analytics
cards.text: Harness data to drive smarter business decisions. Learn to analyse trends, visualise information and use quantitative tools to impact marketing, finance, and strategy with data-driven insights.

cards.title: Business Psychology
cards.text: Explore how psychological principles influence workplace behaviour, leadership, decision-making and team dynamics to optimise performance and culture.
